title: Talk:See-Threepio (Reflections II Foil)
text:
== Build notes ==
The Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil publication was checked against [[:File:Reflections-II-Foil-L-See-Threepio-PSA-photo-135369044-original.jpg|the original physical foil photograph]] from PSA Set Registry source collection. The original JPEG and provenance are retained on the File page. Printed wording, symbols and statistics were read from this face independently of earlier printings. Publication identity is separate from any playable mapping.

[[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 12:59, 14 November 2026 (UTC)

== Earlier printing link ==
The foil photograph shows the printed title See-Threepio and the Special Edition expansion symbol. The existing [[See-Threepio]] redirect leads to [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)]], which currently documents the Premiere printing and its different game text. The navigation link is labeled Card family to describe that relationship accurately. The foil retains its independently transcribed Special Edition wording; an exact non-foil Special Edition publication requires separate identity work.
